Plot dose-response curves

Source: R/plot.R
mst_plot_dose_response.Rd

Draws the response at each concentration, with error bars if data has an error column, and optionally the fitted curves. Requires ggplot2.

Usage

mst_plot_dose_response(
  data,
  fits = NULL,
  concentration = ligand_concentration,
  response = response,
  colour = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of dose-response data, such as from read_mst_dose_response() or mst_fnorm().

fits

Optionally, a tibble of fits from mst_fit() to draw.

concentration, response, colour

<data-masking> The columns of ligand concentration, response, and colour of the points.

Value

A ggplot.

Examples

doses <- read_mst_dose_response(
  tidymst_example("dppr10-cy5_dose-response-flat.xlsx")
)
fits <- mst_fit(doses, .by = target)
mst_plot_dose_response(doses, fits, colour = target)
